aca_25_avg.quote: To safeguard the academic success of every student, all student employees are limited to a rolling average of 25 hours per week for the year.

f1_weekly_20.quote: You are not allowed to work more than 20 hours per week during the fall and spring semesters.

f1_break_40.quote: If you have more than one employer, you are only allowed to work for a total of 20 hours per week combined during the semester and 40 hours per week combined during the summer semester/winter or spring break.

fws_award.quote: You can only earn up to the amount of your FWS award.

weekly_40.quote: Students should not work more than a total of 40 hours per week.

class_time.quote: Federal Work-Study or hourly student employees may not work during the hours they are scheduled to be in class.

coverage_on_student.quote: Be proactive about finding shift coverage (if applicable).

stats.quote: Approximately 10,000 students work at ASU each year, creating an opportunity to build transferable skills and career readiness at scale.
